name: Thinking_1
short_caption: The robot brings its hands together in front of its waist and tilts its head slightly as if contemplating or thinking.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot brings both hands inward toward the center of its waist. The right hand cup-shapes underneath while the left hand hovers slightly above, mimicking a thoughtful, hands-joined posture, accompanied by a subtle head tilt. The hands then gently separate and return down to the neutral resting position.
